jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content . Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds. Founded in 2021 , we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris , growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo. If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media , and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure . Role Overview As our Talent Acquisition Manager , you’ll be ScorePlay’s only recruiter, with full ownership of how we find, assess and hire the people who fuel our growth. You’ll work directly with the founders and every hiring manager, and you’ll see the impact of each hire on the business. The bar is high, and you own it. We’d rather keep a seat open than fill it with the wrong person, and we count on you to hold every hiring manager to that standard, from engineers in Europe to sellers in the US. Most of your week is running searches with a sales mindset: sourcing, screening, closing. The rest is making them work better, with sharper funnel data, better hiring-manager habits and smarter use of AI.
